verdict.rationale: Testing in a sandbox is a fair question for a fraud-prevention API like Signifyd, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a sandbox, test environment, test API keys, or any way to separate test traffic from production. The cited docs cover only production API endpoints, webhooks, SDKs and sensitive-data rejection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
